segments.name: Cruise vacations
segments.description: Operates global cruise vacation brands and private land-based destinations for travelers worldwide.
segments.evidence: As a result, our brands have been aggregated as a single reportable segment based on the similarity of their economic characteristics, types of consumers, regulatory environment, maintenance requirements, supporting systems and processes as well as products and services provided.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay ticket prices for cruise vacations, recognized over the duration of each cruise, plus onboard and other revenues from activities, services and packages.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our revenues are derived from passenger cruise contracts which are reported within Passenger ticket revenues in our consolidated statements of comprehensive income (loss).

changes.text: In 2025, Celebrity Cruises announced the launch of Celebrity River Cruises, a new premium river cruise business.
changes.evidence: In 2025, Celebrity Cruises announced the launch of Celebrity River Cruises, offering a premium river cruise vacation with a new fleet including agreements for the commitment of an initial order of 10 ships.
